title: Prediction range (interval) around the Hybrid forecast, with category and school-decision ranges
gate_interpretation: Exact-category accuracy of a single value was 66-72 % in earlier tests, so an 85 % gate cannot refer to it. It is interpreted as RANGE ACCURACY: the share of test days on which the actual AQI category lies inside the predicted category range. A range is only useful if it is narrower than the naive 'point category +/- 1' (3 categories, 98.5 % coverage in 2025), so the gate also requires a mean range of fewer than 3 categories.
point_forecast: Hybrid (V2 if all 7 day-parts, else V1), production recipe, seed 42, unchanged

methods.M1_conformal_global: split-conformal on log1p residuals (log1p(actual) - log1p(prediction)), one pair of quantiles for all days
methods.M2_conformal_by_level: same, quantiles per predicted-level bucket (<60, 60-120, >120 ug/m3; buckets with < 40 calibration days use M1)
methods.M3_cqr: XGBoost quantile regression (5 % / 95 % of the log-change target, same features and parameters as V1/V2, routed like the Hybrid) with conformal correction (CQR)

calibration: strictly out-of-sample residuals dated BEFORE the test period: models trained on targets up to the end of the previous year predict the following months with archived 24 h forecast weather (days with no archived forecast are not used); no ERA5 substitution
method_choice_rule: chosen on a split of the calibration period only (first half fits, second half scores: smallest |coverage - nominal| then smallest Winkler score); never on test results
not_included: crop-fire (stubble burning) data: no such data exists in the project and the user asked to proceed with existing data only; it is deferred until the user supplies it
protect: production code is imported read-only; no model, default, dashboard or Lambda is changed
